backtest_protocol.execution_model: Annual CapEx, depreciation/amortization, and revenue are read from raw SEC Companyfacts tags and are known only by filed date (<= signal date). Current and prior annual CapEx are matched to same-period D&A and revenue by fiscal-year end. The rule requires CapEx/D&A to rise into a productive replacement-cycle range while revenue is not contracting and CapEx growth is bounded relative to revenue growth. Price confirmation uses only signal-date OHLCV. Paper entry is the next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus replay-only broad warehouse default-off paper overlay

2_history_check.exp-20260616-003: Rejected R&D intensity acceleration. This run tests tangible reinvestment relative to depreciation, not innovation expense.

pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md canonical three windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must be positive, no window EV/PnL regression, at least two EV-improved windows, at least 20 paper trades across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, concentration pass, and accepted compression/distribution candidate-pool comparators must be beaten. Replay-only positives are leads until shared daily/backtest parity exists.

prediction.confidence_reason: The D&A and fixed-asset turnover scouts were positive in aggregate but failed old_thin/drawdown; both explicitly named capex-to-D&A replacement-cycle context as materially different PIT evidence. The risk is high because recent raw Companyfacts quality sources often relabel liquid momentum and fail at least one canonical window.

execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing raw SEC annual CapEx/D&A/revenue pair, missing prior annual comparison pair, stale facts, missing CIK mapping, excluded sector, missing OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate

execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same raw SEC tag mapping, filed-date PIT annual CapEx/D&A reinvestment-cycle gate, liquid SPY-relative confirmation, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.
